headline: Quantum Structure, Circuits, and Correlation
summary: Today's papers explore structural bounds and simplifying representations across quantum systems. Highlights include topological limits on photonic entanglement, Hamiltonian transformations for non-reciprocal circuits, and an effective temperature framework for electron correlation.

themes.title: Quantum Hardware and Circuits
themes.body: Theoretical frameworks for designing and understanding quantum setups, from graph-theoretic bounds on photonic GHZ states to non-reciprocal superconducting circuit duality.

themes.title: Many-Body Correlation Theory
themes.body: Developing tractable mathematical formalisms to capture complex quantum interactions at mean-field computational cost.

connections.body: Both 2610.22190 and 2610.22145 use formal graph and circuit network dualities to derive fundamental constraints and simplifications for physical quantum architectures.
